title: xdrip shows no data from libre2 Patch
symptom: After installing the patched Libre2 app and the newest xDrip on an S8 with Android 9, no BG values appear in xDrip. The user chose 'libre patched app' as data source, files and location permissions are ON for the LibreApp, and all alarms are on in the LibreApp, but no data is received.
cause: The issue was resolved by deleting the Bluetooth file, as suggested in a linked ticket. Additionally, for some users, the problem was caused by the phone being on silent mode, which prevented the Libre2 app from setting alarms, and switching to vibration mode fixed it.
fix: Delete the Bluetooth file (as per the linked ticket) to resolve the issue. For others, ensure the phone is not on silent mode; set it to vibration or sound to allow the Libre2 app to set alarms.
evidence_quote: @k2s: bluetooth file delete solved the problem!!!!!
